alt: A glowing morning sun seen through a single dark-ink shoji opening; the shoji frame, not a superimposed character, is the shape of 日, while a low horizon glows through its two panes.
mnemonic: Day begins when the sun fills the 日-shaped window.

alt: A slim hanging crescent-moon lantern in a quiet night sky; its illuminated rim follows 月 exactly, with two cloud bands crossing the interior like lantern ribs.
mnemonic: Two cloud bands cross the 月-shaped moon that marks each month.

alt: A compact campfire whose four separate tongues of flame are the four strokes of 火; a tiny charcoal bed sits well below the glyph so it cannot read as another stroke.
mnemonic: Four spreading flames draw 火 in the heart of the fire.

alt: A waterfall splitting around a central rock into three lively streams; the water ribbons themselves form 水, with no extra wave lines near the main silhouette.
mnemonic: One waterfall branches into the four flowing strokes of 水.

alt: A single pruned orchard tree whose trunk, branch, and two roots are literally 木; foliage appears only as sparse pale paper-cut clusters behind the stroke-branches so the silhouette remains dominant.
mnemonic: A trunk, one branch, and two roots grow into 木, the tree.

alt: A cutaway gold mountain built from the exact 金 skeleton: the peaked rock roof, mineral strata, mine shaft, and two exposed nuggets all belong to one coherent geological cross-section.
mnemonic: Follow the shaft and strata of 金 to two nuggets and a seam of gold.

alt: A minimal soil cross-section where a straight seedling root pierces a short surface line and reaches a long bedrock line, making the entire earth diagram read as 土.
mnemonic: A root passes through the two layers of 土, the soil.

alt: A traveler in a simple kimono takes one long step; the two sweeping sides of the garment and legs are the only two structural marks, meeting at the shoulder to form 人.
mnemonic: A person leans forward on two walking legs shaped like 人.

alt: A book-tree: a spare 木-shaped tree grows from an open page-like patch of earth, and a bright short band marks the root—the added stroke that turns 木 into 本.
mnemonic: Mark the root of the book-tree: 本 means a book and the place of origin.

alt: A compact streetside conversation kiosk shaped as 語: the left half is a stack of spoken message strips ending in a square speech opening, and the right half is a five-bar speaking screen above a second mouth opening.
mnemonic: Stack spoken signs beside an answering mouth and the whole kiosk becomes 語, language.

alt: A child studies beneath a small school canopy; three chalk sparks hover above the roof, and every architectural or figure edge is assigned to a stroke of 学.
mnemonic: A child beneath a roof catches three bright ideas: 学 is learning.

alt: A newborn rice shoot rises through two clean earth layers; the plant and ground lines are inseparable from the five-stroke silhouette of 生.
mnemonic: A new shoot crosses the soil in the five strokes of 生, life and birth.

alt: A trail leader strides at the front carrying a small pennant; the complete figure, belt, and splayed legs form 先 while one faint path recedes behind, never crossing the glyph.
mnemonic: The pennant-bearing leader stands 先—first and ahead on the path.

alt: A rice stalk stands beside a tied personal pouch; the stalk is 禾 and the knotted pouch is 厶, joined compositionally as the complete 私 rather than illustrated beside a printed glyph.
mnemonic: Beside the grain, a tied pouch is mine alone: 私 means I or private.

alt: Three sheer Japanese rock pillars rise from one connected ridge; the cliffs use the upright geometry of 山 instead of generic triangular peaks.
mnemonic: Three rock pillars share one ridge to become 山, the mountain.

alt: An aerial river delta reduced to three parallel ink-blue channels flowing top to bottom; tiny banks and reeds sit outside the channels and never interrupt the clean 川 rhythm.
mnemonic: Three parallel currents flow together as 川, the river.

alt: A straight-down aerial view of one rice paddy divided into exactly four flooded plots; the raised perimeter levee and two crossing irrigation dikes are the five strokes of 田.
mnemonic: Four flooded plots inside one levee make 田, the rice field.

alt: A pale Noh-inspired mask fills the center, but its open dark mouth is an exact square 口 and the sole high-contrast feature; facial details are ghosted far away from the opening.
mnemonic: The mask opens one square mouth: 口 is a mouth or opening.

alt: A single upright editorial eye, recalling the ancient eye pictograph rotated vertically; its squared eyelid and two iris bands reproduce 目 without a separate pupil mark.
mnemonic: Turn the eye upright and its lid and iris bands become 目.

alt: A sumo-sized festival figure stands frontally with arms stretched wide and legs planted apart; the body gesture itself is the three-stroke 大, with a small head floating just above the junction.
mnemonic: A person stretches arms and legs as wide as possible to show 大, big.
